newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp sees better profit in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp sees better profit in 96/97.

text.p: Wine, packaging and appliance manufacturing group Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Monday its directors were confident the group's earnings would continue to improve in the year to June 30, 1997, provided there was no significant downturn in the Australian and U.S. economies.
In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange, Southcorp said its continuing focus would be on targeting investment towards the growth parts of its business.
"This strategy has already produced results at Southcorp Wines and will deliver continuing improvements in packaging," Southcorp managing director Graham Kraehe said.

Kraehe said the current year should continue an improving trend for its appliance division despite the weaker Australian housing market and uncertainty in the pricing environment for its U.S. water heater group.

Southcorp's launch of its new Hoover laundry, refrigeration and floorcare ranges in August was a key element in meeting the difficult market conditions in the Australian appliance business, Kraehe said.
Southcorp said earlier on Monday that its net profit before abnormals for the year to June 30, 1996 rose to A$118.2 million from A$115.3 million in the previous year.
Kraehe said this was a pleasing result given the flat economic conditions in Australia during the year.
"Our overall results show that we are now able to see the benefits of our initiatives to position Southcorp for growth," Kraehe said.
At 1.25 p.m. (0325 GMT), Southcorp shares were one cent weaker at A$3.17.
